column3: No answer, huh? Let's hang up.
Hey mister, wanna have some fun?
That's exactly what makes it exciting, isn't it?
I guess that's how it goes...
It's a high-tech world now, so this kind of thing really gets to you.
How about it, mister? Wanna do it with me?
We both want the same thing, right?
That's the going rate. Such a cheapskate.
Cheapskate? You call me a cheapskate?!
I'll be the one to hang up!
...Let's just stop here? I'll hang up.
Surprisingly calm about it, aren't you?
You too?! Not you as well!!
Gillian, in a way I've reconsidered my opinion of you.
What'll you do? Wanna give it a try?
A quiz, huh? Said something about winning a fancy prize?
Isn't that just a lucky streak?
Damn! Did I get it wrong?!
So it's true you bought the Pilot Disk?
Huh? Didn't I just hear a voice?
Not the fancy prize, but... another quiz?
Anyway, let's hang up for now.
Is it okay to just hang up like this?
No need to worry, I remember this line's number.
Not the fancy prize, but... oh well.
Yeah, yeah, I get it already...
Damn! Did I get it wrong?!
Hasn't this service already been busted and shut down?
Hey!! Metal?! You hung up on me?!
What a waste! I'll pick up right where I left off.
I even got to appear on TV, and even showed up on the Pilot Disk...
Oh, that reminds me... did everyone buy the Pilot Disk?
If you did, that would make Hayasaka even happier...!
Yes. Assistant Director Inoue has a wife.
Grr, cheeky for a lowly underling! And here I'm even separated!
Please calm down. He's probably cooped up at the office anyway. He can't do a thing.
That's right. I haven't even seen my husband's face lately...
Now, now, calm down... just leave a guy like that be, and go out and have some fun.
I'll do that. Thank you so much.
I finally got off work and came home, and my wife's not here. Grrr!!
That wife of mine... she still hasn't come home.
Is it really okay to say things that could break up someone else's family?
It's fine. They say misery loves company.
...Gillian, do you hold some kind of grudge against that AD?
My advice earlier really worked, huh?
Did you hear that, Metal? Total success.
I bought a new car recently.
Currently looking for a cute girl to sit in the passenger seat.
I'm away right now, so try again later. I'll be waiting!
But I just scraped the whole passenger door. And it's only got 500km on it...
Figures, coming from a disciple of the Crash King.
I'm sending it in for repairs, so hang tight a while.
Come on, that's enough about that already...
There's been a lot going on, but...
Once again, looking for a cute girl to sit in the passenger seat.
Hello. Oh, mom, phone for you!
Uh-huh, oh, is that so. Got it. Well, if you'll excuse me, I'll go pee now.
It's always me... no way out of it.
I'm gonna head over to Dr. Hiromoto's place for a bit.
Go play with Yanai for a while?
Say hi to your wife for me.
I think he's gone to Dr. Hiromoto's to shoot the breeze...
I'll tell you the quiz answer. I look like Agnes Lamune, apparently...
Itcho, hurry up and come home?
No... it's not Matsubana. It's Matsuhana. No dots on it.
Matsu as in pine tree, Hana as in flower field.
Not 'wait-nose'. Pleased to meet you. Click!!
I'm at the insurance office right now about last week's accident.
Please get back to me later. ...Beep!!
Oh, this is Matsuhana. Sorry about the other day.
...No no, that parking lot accident last month is all settled now.
The one where the bicycle crashed into me on Awaji Island? That kid's doing fine now, I hear.
The rice-paddy runaway incident in February went fine too. Well, my whole bonus got drained, but...
Oh. The car break-in... I got my bag back, at least.
Though they cleaned out all the cash first, of course...
The broken leg from the truck collision two years back? Yeah, it's healed up fine, thanks to you.
And then just the other day my battery died on me.
While taking it out, some battery fluid got on my jeans and dissolved them right through.
I really am an insurance agent's nightmare, aren't I. Even I have to laugh. Hahahaha. Click!!
...This is Matsuhana. Let me give you the answer to Quiz 2.
Number of accidents: 8 times. Number of narrow escapes: 2 times.
My wild new book is on sale now.
A demonic gun that'll blow your mind away!!
As long as you're holding onto that, there's no way you'll forget me.
If we say goodbye now, while I still feel the same as when I said I loved you...
You like me that much, huh?
...Hide, turn the TV off when it's over, okay!
Will you come flying to me when I'm lonely at night?
If I call you from the top of the Himalayas and ask you to come get me, will you come?
If you don't get to bed soon you'll be late tomorrow, you know?
Come on, right when we're about to start, what's with that face...
Right, we should toast to my departure.
Live a little smarter, will you.
Hide!! Seriously, turn the TV off already!
If anything, I've gotten even more beautiful, haven't I?
